notes: The core Tabs family entered the compatibility domain after the Node oracle was removed (619b8c9) and after the pinned @wordpress/block-library@9.42.0 runtime, where the family was still experimental; this case has no 9.42 oracle instrumentation.

Every certified byte comes from the real Gutenberg 23.6 runtime (@wordpress/blocks@15.24.0 + @wordpress/block-library@10.2.0, the release where the family first ships stable): the canonical.html bytes round-trip through that runtime's parse()+serialize() to a fixed point with every block valid, and the registered definitions/saveProbes/renderer probes in generated-registry.php and renderer-probes.json are that runtime's actual output.

repairs.html degrades the authored markup the way generation plausibly would: buttons missing type="button" (invalidates core/tab-list) and comment attributes in authored order. The expected repair regenerates from sourced attributes — labels survive via the tabs query source — and matches the runtime-certified save shapes probed in renderer-probes.json (tabs/anchor-color, tab-list/two-tabs).

save.js for all four blocks reviewed at tag v23.6.0: tabs and tab-panels spread useBlockProps.save() onto a div; tab-list passes {role:'tablist'} so role precedes the generated class, with color/border/spacing skip-serialized to the buttons; tab-panel passes {role:'tabpanel', tabIndex:0} so both precede the anchor id.
